title: Quantum Teleportation (Deferred Measurement)
caption: Teleportation of the state |ψ⟩ = TH|0⟩, prepared on q0 by an H then a T gate, to q2. Measurements are deferred: the classical corrections are replaced by a CNOT from q1 and a CZ from q0. Undoing the preparation (T†, then H) on q2 returns |0⟩, so measuring q2 yields 0 with probability 1.
checkable_claims: q2 ends in the state prepared on q0
